instruction: I want to enable format on save in VS Code so that my code is automatically formatted whenever I save a file. Please configure this setting.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save in VSCode. Evaluator checks if settings.json contains 'editor.formatOnSave': true. Using existing check_json_settings metric from vscode.py.
